assessment.name: FinScope contextualization and NBR cross-channel assessment
assessment.FinScope_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
assessment.temporal_method: Observed endpoint and successive direction only; missing periods are never imputed and administrative observations are not converted to FinScope percentages.

sufficiency_rules.insufficient_evidence: Fewer than three unique eligible NBR reporting dates; two successive changes cannot be observed.
sufficiency_rules.limited_evidence: Three or four reporting dates, or any quality qualification, or a proxy rather than a contextual indicator.
sufficiency_rules.sufficient_for_directional_assessment: At least five unique eligible dates, same exact series scope, and no attached quality qualification. This does not imply long-term stability or model accuracy.

assessment.cross_channel_method: Compare directions only on shared reporting dates and matched geography, gender, age-segment, and institution filters. Keep metrics separate; no combined score or causal inference.

source_data.reporting_date_semantics: NBR snapshot_date is the reporting date; collected_at is provenance.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: K1. You have a bank account in your name?
indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage of respondents who own a bank account in their own name.
indicator_mappings.survey_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
indicator_mappings.survey_denominator: Valid item responses among respondents aged 16+; estimates use pop_wt. Per-indicator valid counts are in data/processed/indicator_denominator_validation.csv.
indicator_mappings.interpretation: Higher values indicate greater reported bank-account ownership. Ownership does not necessarily indicate active account use.

nbr_relationships.limitations: Branch presence is not individual account ownership.
nbr_relationships.unit_policy: Retain the NBR source label and unit metadata. Customer/count uniqueness and KPI denominators are not inferred.
nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: F5. Which statement best describes your mobile-money experience?
indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage who describe themselves as a registered mobile-money user (the first response option of question F5).
indicator_mappings.survey_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
indicator_mappings.survey_denominator: Valid item responses among respondents aged 16+; estimates use pop_wt. Per-indicator valid counts are in data/processed/indicator_denominator_validation.csv.
indicator_mappings.interpretation: Registered users who have never used the service, or who no longer use it, are separate F5 categories and are not counted here. The figure is therefore lower than the published headline for registered mobile wallets.

nbr_relationships.limitations: Subscriber definition and KPI denominator are undocumented; district Customers is a separate measure.
nbr_relationships.unit_policy: Retain the NBR source label and unit metadata. Customer/count uniqueness and KPI denominators are not inferred.
nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

nbr_relationships.limitations: District sums exceed the national KPI on all four stored dates.
nbr_relationships.unit_policy: Retain the NBR source label and unit metadata. Customer/count uniqueness and KPI denominators are not inferred.
nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: H2_1. Borrowed money during the past 12 months
indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage who reported borrowing money in the past 12 months.
indicator_mappings.survey_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
indicator_mappings.survey_denominator: Valid item responses among respondents aged 16+; estimates use pop_wt. Per-indicator valid counts are in data/processed/indicator_denominator_validation.csv.
indicator_mappings.interpretation: Measures recent borrowing activity from any source, not access to formal credit. Borrowing is not automatically positive or negative.

nbr_relationships.limitations: The reporting period, unit, and customer-count uniqueness are undocumented; this is not the survey's 12-month measure.
nbr_relationships.unit_policy: Retain the NBR source label and unit metadata. Customer/count uniqueness and KPI denominators are not inferred.
nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: g3a. Saving with - Do not save
indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage classified as not saving by any mechanism.
indicator_mappings.survey_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
indicator_mappings.survey_denominator: Valid item responses among respondents aged 16+; estimates use pop_wt. Per-indicator valid counts are in data/processed/indicator_denominator_validation.csv.
indicator_mappings.interpretation: A financial-vulnerability signal, not a direct measure of access to savings services.

nbr_relationships.limitations: Definition and customer-count uniqueness are undocumented; this is not the inverse of not saving.
nbr_relationships.unit_policy: Retain the NBR source label and unit metadata. Customer/count uniqueness and KPI denominators are not inferred.
nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

nbr_relationships.limitations: This does not cover all saving mechanisms and is not the inverse of not saving.

nbr_relationships.demographic_policy: Use only exact observed Gender filters. NBR Youth/Non-Youth categories are not crosswalked to FinScope age bins.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: E9b. Set aside emergency/rainy-day funds to cover expenses
indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage of respondents who report setting aside emergency or rainy-day funds.
indicator_mappings.survey_population: Rwanda residents aged 16 years and older
indicator_mappings.survey_denominator: Valid item responses among respondents aged 16+; estimates use pop_wt. Per-indicator valid counts are in data/processed/indicator_denominator_validation.csv.
indicator_mappings.interpretation: A financial-resilience signal. It does not measure the amount saved or whether funds would cover a major emergency.
indicator_mappings.nbr_no_relevant_data_reason: No relevant data identified from the NBR data currently available to this project.

indicator_mappings.source_variable_label: g3a. Saving with a group such as a coop, VSLA, tontine, ikibina

nbr_relationships.limitations: SACCO customers do not establish group-saving participation or cover other group forms.

indicator_mappings.measurement_definition: Percentage of all respondents who currently use a savings group they save with or borrow from. Respondents who never used one are counted as non-users.
